# Monkyfi Connect — public brochure

This tree is the **replacement** for [github.com/danteruiz23/Monkyfi-demo](https://github.com/danteruiz23/Monkyfi-demo). Copy it to that repo's default branch (it should not stay as a path on monkyfi.com).

Public, non-sensitive brochure for [Monkyfi Connect](https://www.monkyfi.com/connect).

It matches [www.monkyfi.com](https://www.monkyfi.com): **Poppins** + **JetBrains Mono**, cyan `#4FA9E8`, cream `#F2C98B`, ink `#070B14`, navy `#0A1426`, 10px buttons, Connect node SVG, glyphs ◈ ⚡ ◎.

## Live intake and chatbot

There is **no second chatbot** in this repo (no Gemini, no keyword bot). Book an AI Assessment and talk to the production Monkyfi assistant (Claude, with site guardrails) on the same origin:

- Chatbot intake: https://www.monkyfi.com/connect?chat=intake
- Homepage form: https://www.monkyfi.com/#intake
- Email: hello@monkyfi.com

## What this is not

- Not a scoring engine, readiness calculator, or internal review dashboard
- Not Atlas or Sentinel as live products — those remain *coming soon* on the website, human-in-the-loop
- Not an AI Studio / Gemini export

## Local preview

Open `index.html` in a browser, or serve the folder:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8080
```
